verdict.rationale: Paddle documents Sandbox as a separate environment with completely separate datasets, credentials and dashboards. Sandbox-prefixed API keys authenticate only against sandbox endpoints, and there is a dedicated sandbox MCP endpoint, so agents can test without touching live data; agent skills also cover sandbox testing and the MCP can simulate events. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of sandbox isolation, and sandbox coverage for Paddle Retain (documented as live-only).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: Sandbox is a separate Paddle environment for building and testing your integration without affecting real data or accepting real payments.
Sandbox and live accounts have the same features and APIs but completely separate datasets, credentials, and dashboards.
Generate integration code, configure webhooks, and simulate events for testing.
